sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 令 t=x₁+⋯+x_k，反设 t<1，并令 u=x_k。由 x₁≥⋯≥x_k≥0 可知 0≤u≤t/k<1/k<1，且对 i≤k 有 u≤x_i≤t<1。
第一步，估计尾项。对 i>k，由 x_i≤u 和 m≥2 得 x_i^m=x_i·x_i^{m−1}≤x_i·u^{m−1}≤x_i u，因为 0≤u<1。于是
Σ_{i=k+1}^n x_i^m≤u Σ_{i=k+1}^n x_i≤u(k−t)，其中最后一步由条件（ii）得到。

第二步，由条件（i）可得
Σ_{i=1}^k x_i^m≥1−Σ_{i=k+1}^n x_i^m≥1−u(k−t)。

第三步，对每个 i≤k，因为 0≤u≤x_i≤1 且 m≥2，有
x_i^m−u x_i≤x_i²−u x_i≤x_i−u。
第一个不等式由 x_i^{m−2}≤1 得到；第二个不等式等价于 (x_i−u)(x_i−1)≤0。

第四步，将第二步两边减去 ut，并利用第三步求和：
1−uk≤Σ_{i=1}^k(x_i^m−u x_i)≤Σ_{i=1}^k(x_i−u)=t−uk。
整理得 1≤t，与反设 t<1 矛盾。因此 x₁+⋯+x_k≥1，证毕。

run.statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ), 2 ≤ m → 2 ≤ k → k ≤ n → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → 0 ≤ x i) → (∀ i j : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ j → j ≤ n → x j ≤ x i) → (1 : ℝ) ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m) → Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun i => x i) ≤ (k : ℝ) → (1 : ℝ) ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => x i)
run.proofTerm:
by
  intro m n k x hm hk hkn hx_nonneg hmono hpow hsum
  let t : ℝ := Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => x i)
  let u : ℝ := x k
  by_contra hnt
  have ht : t < 1 := by
    have hnt' : ¬ (1 : ℝ) ≤ t := by
      simpa [t] using hnt
    exact not_le.mp hnt'
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hx_nonneg_Icc1k : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, 0 ≤ x j := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
    exact hx_nonneg j hj.1 (le_trans hj.2 hkn)
  have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact hx_nonneg k hk1 hkn
  have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := by
    have hk_mem : k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨hk1, le_rfl⟩
    have h := Finset.single_le_sum hx_nonneg_Icc1k hk_mem
    simpa [t, u] using h
  have hu_lt_one : u < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu_le_t ht
  have pow_le_sq_of_nonneg_le_one : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 → a ^ m ≤ a ^ 2 := by
    intro a ha0 ha1
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
    calc
      a ^ (2 + d) = a ^ 2 * a ^ d := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≤ a ^ 2 * 1 := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        · exact pow_le_one₀ ha0 ha1
        · exact sq_nonneg a
      _ = a ^ 2 := by ring
  have source_step_0 :
      0 ≤ u ∧ u < 1 ∧
        (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → 0 ≤ x i ∧ u ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ t ∧ x i < 1) := by
    refine ⟨hu_nonneg, hu_lt_one, ?_⟩
    intro i hi1 hik
    have hi_mem : i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨hi1, hik⟩
    have hxi_nonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hx_nonneg i hi1 (le_trans hik hkn)
    have hxi_le_t : x i ≤ t := by
      have h := Finset.single_le_sum hx_nonneg_Icc1k hi_mem
      simpa [t] using h
    have hux : u ≤ x i := by
      dsimp [u]
      exact hmono i k hi1 hik hkn
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_t ht
    exact ⟨hxi_nonneg, hux, hxi_le_t, hxi_lt_one⟩
  have source_step_1 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n → (x i) ^ m ≤ u * x i := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ i := by omega
    have hxi_nonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hx_nonneg i hi1 hin
    have hxi_le_u : x i ≤ u := by
      dsimp [u]
      exact hmono k i hk1 (le_of_lt hki) hin
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_trans hxi_le_u (le_of_lt hu_lt_one)
    have hpow_le_sq : (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_sq_of_nonneg_le_one (x i) hxi_nonneg hxi_le_one
    have hsq_le : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ u * x i := by
      calc
        (x i) ^ 2 = x i * x i := by ring
        _ ≤ u * x i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxi_le_u hxi_nonneg
    exact le_trans hpow_le_sq hsq_le
  have hsplit : Finset.Icc 1 n = Finset.Icc 1 k ∪ Finset.Icc (k + 1) n := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_union]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      by_cases hik : i ≤ k
      · left
        exact ⟨hi.1, hik⟩
      · right
        constructor
        · omega
        · exact hi.2
    · intro hi
      rcases hi with hi | hi
      · exact ⟨hi.1, le_trans hi.2 hkn⟩
      · exact ⟨by omega, hi.2⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.Icc 1 k) (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro i hik hit
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hik hit
    omega
  have hsum_split :
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun i => x i)
        = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => x i)
          + Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => x i) := by
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
  have hsum_pow_split :
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
        = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
          + Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m) := by
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
  have source_step_2 :
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
        ≤ u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := by
    have htail_x_le :
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => x i) ≤ (k : ℝ) - t := by
      have htail_eq :
          Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => x i)
            = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) (fun i => x i) - t := by
        rw [hsum_split]
        simp only [t]
        ring
      linarith
    have htail_pow_le :
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
          ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => u * x i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
      exact source_step_1 i (by omega) hi.2
    calc
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
          ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => u * x i) := htail_pow_le
      _ = u * Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => x i) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail_x_le hu_nonneg
  have source_step_3 :
      (1 : ℝ) - u * ((k : ℝ) - t)
        ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m) := by
    have hhead_ge :
        (1 : ℝ) - Finset.sum (Finset.Icc (k + 1) n) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
          ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m) := by
      linarith [hpow, hsum_pow_split]
    linarith [hhead_ge, source_step_2]
  have source_step_4 :
      ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ m - u * x i ≤ x i - u := by
    intro i hi1 hik
    have hxi_nonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hx_nonneg i hi1 (le_trans hik hkn)
    have hux : u ≤ x i := by
      dsimp [u]
      exact hmono i k hi1 hik hkn
    have hi_mem : i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨hi1, hik⟩
    have hxi_le_t : x i ≤ t := by
      have h := Finset.single_le_sum hx_nonneg_Icc1k hi_mem
      simpa [t] using h
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_trans hxi_le_t (le_of_lt ht)
    have hpow_le_sq : (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_sq_of_nonneg_le_one (x i) hxi_nonneg hxi_le_one
    have hsq_sub : (x i) ^ 2 - u * x i ≤ x i - u := by
      have hfac : (x i - u) * (x i - 1) ≤ 0 := by
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
      nlinarith [hfac]
    have hsub : (x i) ^ m - u * x i ≤ (x i) ^ 2 - u * x i :=
      sub_le_sub_right hpow_le_sq (u * x i)
    exact le_trans hsub hsq_sub
  have hsum_sub :
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m - u * x i)
        = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m) - u * t := by
    calc
      Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m - u * x i)
          = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m)
            - Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => u * x i) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m) - u * t := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        all_goals simp [t]
  have source_step_5 :
      (1 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) * u
          ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m - u * x i) ∧
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m - u * x i)
          ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u := by
    constructor
    · rw [hsum_sub]
      have hring : (1 : ℝ) - u * ((k : ℝ) - t) - u * t = 1 - (k : ℝ) * u := by ring
      linarith [source_step_3, hring]
    · have hsum_le :
          Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m - u * x i)
            ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => x i - u) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
        exact source_step_4 i hi.1 hi.2
      have hconst : Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => u) = (k : ℝ) * u := by
        have hcard : (Finset.Icc 1 k).card = k := by
          rw [Nat.card_Icc]
          omega
        rw [Finset.sum_const, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have hright :
          Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => x i - u) = t - (k : ℝ) * u := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        rw [hconst]
        all_goals simp [t]
      calc
        Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => (x i) ^ m - u * x i)
            ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 k) (fun i => x i - u) := hsum_le
        _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u := hright
  have source_step_6 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ t := by
    linarith [source_step_5.1, source_step_5.2]
  linarith [source_step_6, ht]
originalGivenExcerpts: m,n,k 都是正整数，m≥2 且 n≥k≥2。
